frozen_result_boundary.statement: For each regional exact FLRW dust geometry and intrinsic nonzero scalar mode, X_r=(Delta_r,Z_r) has rank two with dDelta_r/dtau_r=-Z_r and dZ_r/dtau_r=-2H_r Z_r-4piG rho_r Delta_r.
The wall-plus-void intrinsic bulk rank is four; the metric 6-2-2 count is only a heuristic cross-check.
k_code, k_w, k_v, carrier, dressed and survey wavenumbers remain distinct.
The GM formal zero-measure domain, finite infinity, radial-null matching and a 3D spatial carrier remain distinct.
Regional dust velocity, wall velocity, tracer velocity, CGI Z and observational velocity divergence remain distinct.
Candidate A remains external, conditional, clean-only, theoretical and non-predictive in normalization.
D3 remains RESOLVED_DERIVED_4_10 with explicit derived_4_10 and printed_4_15 branches and no default.
Compatibility retains C_Delta, C_Z and C_eff; C_P is separate.
Component count is not rank; matching rank remains not countable before a concrete transfer.
T_r=L_D P_r G_r is only a formal pattern until spaces, domains, maps, kernels and data are defined.
Inverse uniqueness and nonuniqueness remain unresolved before a concrete admissible transfer is selected.
Current Timescape machinery does not supply the complete common carrier and regional-to-GM transfer.
